    Registration Management

    Chronorace has developed its own tools to offer you a complete, flexible and customized solution for managing your registrations: a huge time saver on the day of your event!

    An online registration service where we offer a simple and ergonomic standard form. Payment is made on an externally secured website. Display of supporting documents: statistics, allocation of start numbers, Group registrations, Promo codes, Different possible options, ....

    Tracking of participants

    SUIVILIVE

    Live tracking is a management system for your event that is based on a website. This ensures that:

    • The speaker, the supervisors and the audience can follow each participant as well as the changes in the rankings step by step.
    • The organizer can follow the progress of the competition and manage the safety.

    Accessible to the public: looking up the position of a participant by entering the name or bust number.

    Customizable according to your wishes: route plan, a graphical representation of the route, logos of your sponsors ...

    It is required to install remote control points and a network. The data is communicated in different ways depending on the distance: serial link, loop, UHF radio, GSM, GPRS / UMTS.

    GPS TRACKING

    The tracking and the time measurement are done simultaneously via the same chip: It is not necessary to bring a GPS or annoying Smartphone. The ideal solution for triathlon and duathlon. Another option: GPS trackers that are mounted on motos, cars, or on velcro straps: this allows you to continuously monitor the relatives differences. This information is sent back to the command post or to our website.

    Sports and Technology

    Chronorace uses the latest generation of timing equipment to ensure excellent security and reliability.

    Types of Technology

    When running or cycling, our disposable passive chips that are stuck to the start number (or the frame plates) are the best solution. They are very resistant to external influences and are suitable for large mass events (marathon, cycling events ...). The detection line can be over 10 meters wide.

    For triathlon we use waterproof active chips that can be attached to the ankle.

    The active chip, also used in cyclocross, enables sharp timing up to a thousandth of a second. The detection can be performed accurately for speeds up to 80 km per hour. The chip can be detected up to 2 meters from the ground with a precision of 1/100th of a second. The detection systems consist of thin rubber mats with a width of 4 meters.

    In MTB Enduro the starting system saves the time in the chip, the arrival system retrieves the saved times and sends them to the finish.

    For relay events a relay stick is used that is equipped with a chip.

    Our solutions combine great ease of use and advanced technology at very affordable prices.
